metadata.description: Curated marketplace of the most popular agent skills. Every plugin installs from its original upstream repository.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: An opinionated software-development methodology delivered as composable skills: brainstorm, plan, TDD, debug, review, ship. Session hooks make the agent actually use them.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Small, composable engineering skills straight from Matt's .agents directory. Explicitly against process-owning frameworks.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: A single skill distilled from Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls: think first, simplicity, surgical changes, goal-driven execution.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max-skill
plugins.description: Design intelligence for building professional UI across platforms: 192 reasoning rules, 79 searchable styles, a design-system generator.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Cuts about 65% of output tokens by making the agent talk like a caveman while keeping technical accuracy. Plus subagent presets and memory-file compression.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Production-grade engineering skills organized as a lifecycle: define, plan, build, verify, review, ship. Includes slash commands and agent personas.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Ten output rules that stop the agent burying the answer: lead with the next action, number steps, cap lists at five, no preamble.
